ad_intro:
Dr. Sheth's (drshc.com) is a D2C Skincare brand running ~40 active Meta creatives in India with estimated spend Rs.40-60L/mo and ads pointing to website traffic to subscription/checkout. Dermatologist-led skincare brand founded by Dr. Aneesh Sheth.

The funnel leaks at three points: (1) Creative: derm-led but offer-heavy, demo reels thin - The gap: derm-led demo + routine UGC. (2) Landing page: an offer-heavy PDP with no demo or derm trust. (3) Tracking: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific..

These are fixable in 7 days; we estimate ~30-40% of ad spend is wasted. Mid-market/SMB lead - high closability with a fast test budget.
ad_intelligence: Meta (Facebook + Instagram) primary; Google Search + YouTube secondary; app-install where relevant.
Several evergreen creatives running 30+ days - winners, but fatigue risk and a thin refresh cadence.
Category-siloed with limited concept testing; light UGC injection.
findings: Creative leak: Derm-led but offer-heavy, demo Reels thin. The gap: derm-led demo + routine UGC.
Copy leak: Current angle is offer-led. Missing angle: ingredient-efficacy story over offer.
Landing page leak: An offer-heavy PDP with no demo or derm trust.
Tracking leak: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific.
wins: WIN 1 - Creative: Deploy derm-led demo + routine UGC
Shoot 15 fifteen-second derm-led demo + routine UGC and replace 30% of the weakest creatives. Expected: CTR +30-50%, CPA -15-25% within 10 days.
WIN 2 - CRO: Fix the landing experience
Add derm explainers + routine demo UGC on PDPs. Expected: CVR +30-40%.
WIN 3 - Tracking: Server-Side CAPI + Segment Retargeting

Fire Meta Pixel + CAPI server-side on key conversion events; build 3 retargeting audiences (visited but didn't convert / started checkout / dropped off) with segment-specific creatives. Expected: recapture 10-15% of dropped conversions; cleaner attribution.
